regeneration_script:
#!/bin/bash
# Frame regeneration script — deploy when Frame wakes up
# Run from eastGate: sshpass -p 'framegate' ssh steamos@192.168.4.181 < frame-regen.sh

set -e

# Create Gaia directory
mkdir -p /opt/gaia /opt/gaia/data

# Copy binaries (already cross-compiled for ARM64)
echo "Deploying inkFish ARM64..."
# scp from eastGate will push these

# Install Ollama
echo "Installing Ollama for ARM64..."
curl -fsSL https://ollama.com/install.sh | sh

# Pull a small model for local inference
ollama pull tinyllama:1.1b

# Start solar mode
echo "Starting solar panel mode..."
nohup /opt/gaia/inkfish solar > /opt/gaia/solar.log 2>&1 &

echo "Frame regenerated! inkFish + Ollama + Solar active."
